title: Leonardo DiCaprio's birth chart
metaDescription: Leonardo DiCaprio's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.1° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.3° separates the Sun and Saturn from an exact trine; at that range identity and structure read as one mechanism. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 19.1° Scorpio — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Venus stands at 20.4° Scorpio; Mars stands at 9.9° Scorpio. The tradition reads attraction that works by atmosphere from Venus, effort that surges when it matters from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun a third of the circle apart from Saturn, 0.3° off exact. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, Neptune sextile Pluto at 0.4°, and Jupiter square Neptune at 0.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags four placements in this chart. Venus in Scorpio at 20.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Scorpio at 9.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Pisces at 8.1° is in domicile; Saturn in Cancer at 18.8° is in detriment. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 water, 3 air, 1 fire by element and 4 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by mode. Mercury crossed from Libra into Scorpio during that day, so its sign is left open. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn was retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.9° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 21.1°.
